full_judgment: 11. Here, in this case there is no question about the limitation or applicability of section 47 of the Act, 2003 or any other issue to be raised before depositing the entire Court-fees. Rather, the Adalat started process having the full payment of Court-fees. Therefore, we do not find any illegality in continuing with the suit and, as such, the Rule fails.
